title: 10年期收益率近6%：小公司负担更大，数据中心要重算回报？
speaker: Michael Murray Roberts

segments.en: No, we have and it has been very rapid. I mean the the changes that you've seen even from the lows of the Covid era up to now you know 6% on the 10 year almost.
segments.zh: 是的，变化非常快。从疫情时期的低点到现在，10年期收益率几乎达到6%。

segments.en: Is a pretty seismic change and those last changes to your point been very rapid. So I think it will start to filter through I think it's right now a little too early because I think plans were made before to raise capital.
segments.zh: 这是重大变化，而且最近的变化非常快。我认为它会开始传导，但现在还为时过早，因为融资计划之前已经制定。

segments.en: I think however you will start seeing a slowdown you will start seeing people think twice. I think the smaller the company the bigger the burden. And so I think it is going to have an effect.
segments.zh: 但我认为会开始看到放缓，人们会三思。公司越小，负担越大。所以我认为会产生影响。

segments.en: You know now it depends on where you're raising capital how you're raising et cetera. But given the quantum of capital that's being raised in particular for data centers.
segments.zh: 这取决于你在哪里融资、如何融资等。但考虑到正在筹集的资金规模，尤其是数据中心。

segments.en: Higher rays has got to have people start thinking about the returns they can give from these investments. So they can make certain adjustments.
segments.zh: 更高的利率必须让人们开始思考这些配置能带来的回报，以便做出某些调整。

segments.en: You know terms of more leverage less leverage et cetera, but I think those discussions are happening right now.
segments.zh: 更多杠杆或更少杠杆等，我认为这些讨论正在进行中。
